item.title: Saturday Morning, Nov 14
item.description:
The Saturday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 14, 2026: York, Maine weather with the full seven-day forecast; the longest nationwide flight ground stop since 9/11 and what caused it; no deaths after the New Orleans tanker crash; Alaska elects a Democratic governor; Zelensky says U.S. negotiators raised NATO membership for the Donbas; Trump readies for a Shenzhen meeting with Xi and Putin while weighing a pause on Iran strikes; Gaza's flooded tents; Starship reaches orbit but its booster skips the catch, plus Friday's closing numbers; Pope Leo calls the promise of tech-driven immortality a mirage; a hacked drone software update in Germany and Microsoft's November patch problems; your X feed; Maine's proposed data center moratorium and weekend picks; and a man who has picked up 900 bags of litter for his hometown. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
